m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Lemuria isn't a fable, perhaps an invention. The Tree refuses to speak, so we must find... crumbs, no traces, no... proof.
There is proof, a grain of memory not yet lost to the Sands of Time. Mirage, I see/sense/remember something there.
This form... this body... this instantiation can't last... Go to Mirage, Wizard. I'll find you there.
Lemuria? No, no, fresh out. Of course I know what it is. And my Lemurias are the best in the Spiral. That's why I'm out.
I heard a traveler mention visiting Lemuria on his way to El Dorado. But I do not know that I believe him.
You seek Lemuria? Good for you. I seek the help of a brave adventurer. Wait, wait... you are the Wizard who brought peace to the Houses, yes? You will do.
You see, I recently hired the Serpent Social Club for protection. But their fees were high and they did nothing to shoo Ghultures from my wares.
Then they explained that their fees were not for restraining Ghultures, but for restraining themselves. From thievery!
Which hardly seems a reputable business model. So I fired them... and they robbed me, took my wares to a Cave down there.
If you rout these Snakes, I will tell you all I know of Lemoonia or whatever you said.
You cleared out the Snakes? Splendid. Now I can reclaim my goods without further angering the Serpent Social Club.
You know, I don't think they are an honest organization. But they're growing fast. Here, Aggrobah, Rubal Wastes, Alkali Barrows-
Did you say something, Wizard? Anyway, this so-called social club is involved in everything - in protection, shipping/receiving, antiquities.
Now what were you seeking here again? Lemuria? Lemuria? Hmm, I think I... ah... my head. The stress is too much. Apologies, I must rest.
Before, it was me. Singular. A point. No volume. No space around me. No others. A universe in a dot. I was thought and thought was all.
So I stretched and poked, made windows... cavities... to find the Not-Me, the Paradox, You. I became as you were. I did as you did. I attacked.
Then there was... Light, you call it. And Shadow. Intertwined. A Paradox that breached my existence, showing me for the first time... other things.
I saw shapes, and thoughts and actions. I saw what I wasn't and knew what I was: a void, absent everything. I was <BOLD>Nothing</BOLD>.
It felt... hurt? Then you left. The Old One was left. So I gleaned, sifted, learned, and became.
I too am fading. I can't sustain here. The Everything rejects the Nothing. But Lemuria must be found. If only there was someone who could see it...
There you are, Wizzzard. Words... taste funny. I was looking for you. Cavity? Yes, I was in a Cavity. You thought me gone? No.
Not... gone. That is the wrong... form? Conjugation? Going! That is what I am. Soon, you see. I have trouble staying.
I don't remember the Cavity. I remember only abstractions? Thoughts that ache and hurt and gnash and gnaw. I need your help.
There is something I must find, something that will salve the pangs. But I don't know... the Tree!
She saw me. In the Cavity. She sees all. Go to the White Tree. Ask her about Lemuria.
And... please... hurry...
